title: Filing an appeal to the State Commission
description: An appeal against an order of the District Commission

steps.step: The person aggrieved by the order of the District Commission prepares the appeal in the prescribed form and manner
The appeal is filed with the State Commission within forty-five days from the date of the order of the District Commission
If the appeal is filed after the expiry of forty-five days, the State Commission considers whether there was sufficient cause for the delay
If the appellant is required to pay an amount in terms of the order of the District Commission, the appellant deposits fifty per cent of that amount in the prescribed manner before filing the appeal

documents: Proof of deposit of fifty per cent of the amount (if applicable)
